scope_guards: The 6 August 2026 small-development change and 2 November 2026 NSIP start are future date gates and are not applied before their effective dates.
A statutory metric tool is required for mandatory BNG but tool availability does not produce candidate habitat units.
Gain-site registration requires exact ownership or lease evidence, boundary, legal security, metric and management evidence.
Thirty-year legal security is a registration requirement and not proof of completed habitat delivery or current condition.
A gain-site register search result is not an allocation until the exact reference and development allocation are verified.
Statutory credits are a last resort and their availability is not proof of purchase or discharge of a planning condition.
Metric versions, validation flags and off-site reference columns must retain their chronology and completion status.
No score or promotion is written without exact baseline survey, metric, gain-site reference, allocation and planning evidence.
